name: Bryan Q. Miller
description: Salvage tows were a type of starship. The podracers Ben Quadinaros, Barba, and Scorr stole a salvage tow from a spaceport on Black Rock in order to escape from the moon after it was overrun by Kayfoundo Kapa in 29 BBY.
